name: architecture-audit
description: WHEN auditing an existing repository or multi-module subsystem to discover and rank bounded architectural hotspots and decide where investment pays off now; NOT for designing one already-selected module contract (architect), auditing physical directory, package or build-target layout and import enforcement (codebase-layout), breaking hidden dependencies in untestable code (test-seams), simplifying one chosen path (reducer), or editing code (refactoring); returns a read-only Markdown and Mermaid report with qualitative ranking, confidence, counterevidence and next-skill handovers.
